description: Marching-squares-style splat interpolation/upscaling beyond a tileset's native max zoom, as a density fallback once splat_lod_zoom_20260712's zoom ceiling is reached
wave_rationale: User 2026-07-12: explicitly deferred this in favor of splat_lod_zoom_20260712 as the first fix, but then asked to build it in parallel anyway rather than wait for the zoom ceiling to actually be hit.
notes: Dispatched as a parallel worker alongside splat_lod_zoom_20260712 rather than sequenced after it, per direct user request. Interpolation logic is independent of the zoom-selection plumbing (FR-1..FR-5 of the sibling track) so file overlap risk is low, but the two tracks will eventually need to compose: splat_lod_zoom picks the best real tile zoom available; this track kicks in only when that zoom is still below the tileset's max_zoom ceiling need. Coordinator must reconcile SplatChunk shape changes from both tracks at integration time.
